rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making something continue or keeping it going.

example.english: Everyone has to help perpetuate this tradition from one generation to the next.
example.traditional: 呢個傳統要靠大家一代一代咁延續落去。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cyun4 tung2 jiu3 kaau3 daai6 gaa1 jat1 doi6 jat1 doi6 gam3 jin4 zuk6 lok6 heoi3

rows.note: Use this when something is preserved by being passed from person to person or generation to generation.

example.english: Word of mouth has helped perpetuate this story to the present day.
example.traditional: 呢個故事靠口耳相傳，先可以流傳到今日。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gu3 si6 kaau3 hau2 ji5 soeng1 cyun4 sin1 ho2 ji5 lau4 cyun4 dou3 gam1 jat6

rows.note: Use this when repeated actions or support reinforce and help maintain a problem, belief, or harmful tendency.

example.english: Turning a blind eye to false rumours will only perpetuate panic.
example.traditional: 放任假消息，只會助長恐慌。
example.jyutping: fong3 jam6 gaa2 siu1 sik1 zi2 wui5 zo6 zoeng2 hung2 fong1
